Today we published a technical report on Muse Glimmer, our 30B open-weight model built for agentic tasks on consumer hardware.

It runs at practical speeds on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU at 4-bit precision, and leads comparably-sized open models on tool use and https://t.co/PssTwoaTAZ

Germany knows how to build, and now it’s bringing that expertise to industrial AI. 🇩🇪

Tonight in Berlin, @JensenHuang and Chancellor @_FriedrichMerz discussed combining German engineering with NVIDIA AI to advance manufacturing and automotive.
